# shopify_menu (Resource)

A navigation menu. Terraform owns the whole item tree: items added in the admin are removed on the next apply. Import with the menu `handle`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Take over the store's default main menu; destroy only removes it from state.
resource "shopify_menu" "main" {
  handle         = "main-menu"
  title          = "Main menu"
  adopt_existing = true

  item {
    title       = "Care products"
    type        = "COLLECTION"
    resource_id = "gid://shopify/Collection/123"

    item {
      title = "Bed protection"
      type  = "HTTP"
      url   = "/collections/bed-protection"
    }
  }

  item {
    title       = "Guide"
    type        = "PAGE"
    resource_id = "gid://shopify/Page/456"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) Menu handle, e.g. `main-menu`. Can't be changed for default menus.
- `title` (String) Menu title.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing menu with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `item` (Block List) Top-level items, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--item))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Menu GID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is a default menu, which Shopify won't delete.

<a id="nestedblock--item"></a>
### Nested Schema for `item`

Required:

- `title` (String) Link text.
- `type` (String) Item type, e.g. `COLLECTION`, `PAGE` or `HTTP`.

Optional:

- `item` (Block List) Second-level items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--item--item))
- `resource_id` (String) GID of the linked resource, for resource types such as `COLLECTION` or `PAGE`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags to filter a linked collection by.
- `url` (String) Target URL, for `HTTP` items only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <handle>
terraform import shopify_menu.main main-menu
```
